target: Both distinct selected digits appear in the same Open or Close panel.
baseline: The live joint_180 model, on exactly the same eligible events.
hypotheses: Pooling prior pair counts across markets reduces noisy local frequency estimates.
Prior-panel context predicts residual pair appearance after accounting for local frequency.

residual_ridge.refit: At calendar-quarter boundaries, using only prior target outcomes within 28 calendar months.

history.cross_market_availability: Strictly earlier calendar dates. All results for a date are predicted before any are learned.
history.close_information: Pre-result Close only. Same-day Open is excluded.

selection: Choose one challenger by most strict hits during 2021-2023. Candidate-order ties. Never retune on later periods.
promotion_checks: Strict improvement on development, validation, confirmation, and recent periods.
Non-negative net hits on the last 30 and 90 calendar days.
Positive 95% lower bound for mean net hits, resampling whole calendar weeks across 2025 onward, 4000 replicates, seed 20261018.
limitations: These histories have been inspected in earlier studies. This is retrospective research, not pristine independent validation.
Both-digit accuracy remains the target; one-digit hits do not count as successes.
A failed round does not justify changing thresholds or selecting another candidate on the same confirmation data.
No production change is made by the research script. Passing checks would justify a prospective trial.
